blurb: Guests sail Duluth, MN and Superior, WI from the water aboard a 60 foot steel schooner named Charley. Depending on weather, sails go on Lake Superior or down the harbor. Sails operate Fridays and Saturdays out of Loon’s Foot Marine in Superior, WI.
